title: WP900 G10 logical trial identity must not become topology authority
target: F2-WP-900 generation 10 repaired independent semantic mediator ABI

material_observation.repaired_origin_path: The repaired repository ABI now keeps source attestation verifier-side, exposes only schema plus canonical_semantic_json on the treatment-blind trial wire, requires a factory-valid mediator object plus byte-for-byte wire equality for admission, and has green targeted G10 CI plus deterministic release CI at the observed head.
material_observation.remaining_non_authority_label: MediatedSemanticState still stores trial_process_identity supplied by the caller. admit_mediated_semantic_state only checks that this text differs from mediator.source_process_identity; it does not observe an OS process instance. The field is included in MediatedSemanticState.as_dict and therefore influences state_sha256 and downstream execution-receipt binding even though it is not behavioral input.
material_observation.false_green_risk: A later target harness could accidentally treat a caller-selected label, or a digest containing that label, as evidence that source and trial were distinct process instances. Different labels can make state hashes differ while the admission still occurred in one OS process. This is evidence-topology contamination, not a demonstrated semantic behavior failure.
material_observation.minimal_design_correction: Keep repository origin admission and behavioral transport separate from target process evidence. A logical trial label must be explicitly NON_AUTHORITY or removed from promotion-bearing state identity. Real source/trial/executor process independence must be established only by external runtime readback that binds observed process-instance evidence to the exact wire/state/execution subject.

required_discriminator_before_target_pro: Do not award topology or target credit from trial_process_identity inequality or from state_sha256 values that merely incorporate that caller-supplied label.

For the exact frozen G10 runtime subject, independently observe the source process instance and the behavior-capable trial/executor process instance using stable runtime identity sufficient to distinguish PID reuse, bound to the same boot and exact source.
Bind the exact treatment-blind trial wire SHA-256 and admitted semantic-state SHA-256 to those independently observed process instances in the external target receipt.
Verify that no source attestation metadata, treatment class, trial position, arm/condition, source/witness digest or treatment-revealing plan surface is visible to the behavior-capable child.

If the implementation retains trial_process_identity for diagnostics, mark it NON_AUTHORITY and exclude it from any claim of process independence; prefer removing it from promotion-bearing state digest if no deterministic behavior requires it.
duplicate_authority_check: No WP900 source/test/workflow/active-pointer mutation, successor generation, runtime dispatch or second mediator authority is created. This packet narrows the existing process-topology reviewer finding to the exact caller-label/state-digest false-green path.
next_exact_action: Active G10 owner should either remove/mark trial_process_identity non-authoritative before subject freeze or ensure the target controller ignores it completely for topology. Then freeze one exact repaired subject and reuse the established owner-VPS controller lane to produce independently observed source/trial-executor process-instance readback bound to the exact treatment-blind wire/state.
